reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread. I noted that the deadline for Tamsin Cold Chain's signed order form is 24 September and said I hadn't changed anything, since she asked for no action.

I also pointed out two things:
- **The date has already passed.** 24 September is before today (14 October), so she may want to check it again.
- **#north-team hasn't seen the correction.** Her original post is there, so people in that channel will only see the fix if she posts it there too.

I didn't open #north-team or anything else. A signing deadline is an operational date, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat in the channel.
